# display=none on bubbletea takes no line and no focus stop.
#
# A component of its own at run time -- a recursion -- whose root is displayed
# none drew nothing and still took a line in its parent, which joined the
# empty string it rendered. A button displayed none was still a stop: focus
# started on it, so the screen showed none focused, and Tab stopped on it.
# The snapshot is the screen as text.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
# the hidden component's line is gone: below follows above.
grep '(?m)^above *\nbelow *$' app.sngl.snapshots/page.ansi
# focus starts on the first button shown, not the hidden one before it.
! grep 'hidden' app.sngl.snapshots/page.ansi
! grep 'level' app.sngl.snapshots/page.ansi
grep '(?m)^> first *$' app.sngl.snapshots/page.ansi
grep '(?m)^  second *$' app.sngl.snapshots/page.ansi

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output { go { bubbletea } }

var hide = true
var levels = 0

// Recursive, so a component of its own at run time, whose root is displayed
// none at depth 0.
component nest(depth int) ui.node {
    ui.vbox(style={display=depth == 0 ? ui.Display.none : ui.Display.unset}) {
        ui.text(value="level {depth}")
        if depth > 0 {
            nest(depth=depth - 1)
        }
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.vbox {
            ui.text(value="above")
            nest(depth=levels)
            ui.text(value="below")
        }
        ui.button(text="hidden", style={display=hide ? ui.Display.none : ui.Display.unset})
        ui.button(text="first")
        ui.button(text="second")
    }
}

func testPage(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.snapshot("page")
}

ui.window {
    page
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/page/1 --
